purpose: Build a stylized 3D character that matches picked 2D art: clean but not plastic materials, real five-finger hands with grips, natural prop carry, one-number face control, rig, and a side-by-side likeness loop before anything goes to the owner.

model.notes: modelling and likeness judgement; run by a builder agent inside a blender-recorded-build.

owner_approval: GPU use only under a current gpu-time grant
how a prop is carried, when the art does not show it, is asked through the main seat
evaluation: The likeness comparison shows the art above front, three-quarter and profile renders with an honest score of 8 or more out of 10; the hand clash check reports 0 finger vertices through held props; every walk clip passes the walk check; the face is driven by one control.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Blender 5.0 Python modules; no downloaded assets.
